title: PrintAI Real-Request Intent Corpus
description: Balanced Vietnamese print-only request corpus used to measure semantic coverage. It is a coverage set, not a market-frequency sample.

sourceProfiles.multiSource: At least two approved PDF/image sources with stable source order.
sourceProfiles.mixedImages: Multiple approved raster/PDF pages usable as independent print items.
sourceProfiles.largeImage: One approved image or one-page PDF intended for oversized tiled output.

coverageLabels.supported: Representable by current PrintPlan 2.0 / PrintJobSpec 1.0 plus existing deterministic workflows.
coverageLabels.supportedWithCapability: Semantically representable, but physical execution depends on the selected printer/driver advertising the requested paper/capability.
coverageLabels.clarification: The request is materially ambiguous and should produce a user question rather than a guessed print plan.
coverageLabels.gap: Not faithfully representable by the current general print-intent contract/execution path.
coverageLabels.mixed: Category contains both supported and gap cases; each case carries its own label.
